evaluationStatus: Representative corpus only. Natural-language end-to-end execution has not been verified by this audit. Status describes source-level capability, not test results.

questions: How should I split my next paycheck between bills, spending, saving and debt?
limitations: Constrained reserves, paycheck-only gap and one shared optional capacity use canonical forecast; current funds, classified history, settled older obligations and two payday dates required. No arbitrary debt/savings split.

questions: Make me a 30-day plan to stop living paycheck to paycheck.
What should I do over the next 90 days to get ahead?
limitations: Dated read-only checklist and shared capacity cover the requested forecastable window; no guaranteed escape date or invented contribution rate.

questions: How is my financial health, and what is my biggest risk right now?
limitations: Cash-flow lows, income/expense balance and historical pressure signals exist; no comprehensive financial-health score or unsupported diagnosis.

questions: What should I focus on with my money today?
Give me today's financial plan.
families.calculator: Current-plan legacy briefing / analysisReview and analysisStability primitives
limitations: Daily purpose is absent from analysis domain enum; verify current-plan routing does not fall through to saved simulations or an unrelated historical review.

questions: How much is in Main Checking right now?
How much is in Rainy Day Savings?
limitations: Exact active name required; recorded balance is not live available funds.
Account and goal names must not be confused.

questions: How much can I safely spend today?
What can I spend without touching my bill money?
limitations: Needs dated available funds, resolved obligations and classified spending baseline.

questions: What will my balance be September 25?
How much will I have next Friday?
limitations: Household projection only, within configured horizon; distinguish estimated spending.

questions: What will Main Checking have September 25?
limitations: No individual account-level forecast. Must not return household total as the named balance.

questions: What will be left before my next paycheck?
What will I have after Salary arrives?
limitations: Resolve exact income if named; expected deposits are not confirmed receipt.

questions: What will remain after Rent is paid?
limitations: Unique bill and applicable occurrence required.

questions: What is my lowest balance next month?
When will my balance be highest next month?
limitations: Search only requested forecast window.

questions: When will checking reach $1000?
limitations: First threshold crossing is not a sustained protected buffer.

questions: Compare the last week of this month with the first week of next month.
limitations: Preserve both windows; do not infer historical actuals from forecast.

questions: Can I afford a $250 purchase?
limitations: Protect future obligations/cushion, not just today's positive balance.

questions: When is the earliest safe day to buy a $250 appliance?
limitations: Earliest projected date is not verified future available funds.

questions: What if I spend $250 this weekend?
What if I spend $1000 tomorrow?
limitations: Use requested purchase date, not earliest-date search; no real changes.

questions: What bills are due before payday?
What bills remain overdue?
limitations: Explicit overdue purpose checks cross-month configured occurrences within a disclosed 24-month bound; missing origins and older obligations limit completeness.

questions: Did I pay all my bills last month?
limitations: Explicit settlement purpose reconciles configured occurrences and recorded settlements, not unrecorded bills or bank confirmation. Future ranges rejected.

questions: When did I last pay Netflix?
limitations: Explicit last-payment purpose searches retained history rather than default current month; coverage and ambiguity limit last-recorded claims.

questions: What subscriptions do I have?
Which recurring charges increased?
Am I paying for duplicate subscriptions?
limitations: Category and recurring-merchant patterns are not proof of active contracts or duplicate services.

questions: How much income did I receive last month?
limitations: Only recorded posted received income; exclude scheduled deposits, transfers and card refunds.

questions: When and how much is my next paycheck?
limitations: Canonical recurrence, month-level income history and excluded dates; not proof of receipt.

questions: What is my average monthly income?
limitations: Recorded history coverage and exact averaging period must be explicit.

questions: How much did I spend on groceries last month?
How much did I spend at Walmart last month?
limitations: Preserve merchant/category; avoid card purchase plus repayment double counting.

questions: Where did spending rise compared with last month?
limitations: Classified activity and comparable periods required.

questions: Find my $35 transaction.
limitations: Bounded recorded history and ambiguous matches disclosed.

questions: Are there unusual charges?
How much did I pay in fees?
limitations: No fraud or exhaustive fee-detection claim; sparse merchant baseline limits detection.

questions: Show me my debt snowball target.
What required minimum payments remain?
limitations: Current eligible debt and minimum settlement; not saved simulation history.

questions: When will I be debt-free?
How much faster if I add $100 each month?
limitations: Fixed-payment monthly scenario; no cash affordability guarantee; financial question must not be intercepted as app navigation.

questions: When will I finish paying Test Card?
limitations: Selected debt payoff comes from its projected payoff event, not whole-plan timing; excluded or unreached debts and incomplete inputs remain explicit.

questions: How long will it take to have 1000 buffer
When can I build a $1,000 cushion?
How many paychecks until I have a thousand-dollar buffer?
limitations: Purpose/amount-role validation separates target from contribution; above-cushion timeline emits duration, already-reached or not-estimable. Screenshot and paraphrases still require actual interpreter evaluation.

questions: How can I get one paycheck ahead?
How can I get a month ahead?
What is my buffer now?
limitations: Sustainable contribution requires history and forecast; current buffer must not become unprotected total checking.

questions: Am I still living paycheck to paycheck?
limitations: Needs multiple historical pre-payday closes and classified income/expenses; one low balance is insufficient.

questions: Am I improving over the past three months?
How much has my debt fallen?
How much have my savings grown?
limitations: Manual savings/checking deltas use two actual account_balances observations inside the window; sparse endpoints and mixed cohorts explicit. Historical checking closes also supported. Observed debt-principal and connected-bank balance histories are unavailable in existing sources, never inferred from payments or current balances.

questions: How much emergency savings do I need for three months?
Do I have six months of expenses saved?
limitations: Recorded expense baseline; essential-only classification and earmarked/inaccessible funds not inferred.

questions: When will Vacation be funded if I save $100 per paycheck?
How long to save $1000 for Vacation?
I can contribute $100 per paycheck.
limitations: Explicit target/contribution role and cadence support scenario duration or already-met/not-estimable outcomes; contribution is not certified affordable. Follow-up language remains unverified.

questions: What is my credit utilization?
What payment gets Main Card below 30%?
limitations: Requires connected limit/balance; cannot predict credit score or certify payment affordability.

questions: Which card has my highest APR?
Which card has the highest utilization?
limitations: Requested metric controls ranking; unavailable APR or limits and scope remain explicit. No credit-score prediction.

questions: How much grocery budget is left this month?
limitations: Configured category budget and classified activity required.

questions: Make a budget that covers bills, debt and saving without overdrafting.
limitations: Explicit budget-plan purpose combines expected income, existing commitments, living allowance and one cushion-protected capacity. Read-only aggregate draft, not a saved category-by-category budget or arbitrary percentage allocation.

questions: Give me a weekly financial review.
Review last month and tell me what to focus on.
limitations: Historical results and current outlook separate; unavailable debt/savings changes explicitly excluded.

questions: What if my pay falls $200?
What if Rent rises by $100?
What if Rent rises to $1200?
What if I cancel Streaming?
limitations: Absolute new amount versus delta must be distinguished; named occurrence and cadence must be preserved.

questions: What if I move Rent from September 15 to September 20?
limitations: One-off occurrence scenario only; real mutation separately authorized.

questions: Should I put $100 toward debt or savings?
limitations: Primitives exist; no demonstrated composed priority recommendation protecting required payments and cushion.

implementationUpdate: Updated against the frozen candidate after semantic contracts, guidance, history, settlement, search and ranking changes. Main reports 204 Edge tests at this stage; this is not a final receipt or live deployment claim. All natural-language cases remain unverified here.
